Refactor services to use PostgreSQL client and update SQL syntax

- Updated all service files to replace MySQL2 with PostgreSQL client (pg).
- Changed SQL query placeholders from '?' to '' format for parameterized queries.
- Adjusted result handling to accommodate PostgreSQL's query result structure.
- Ensured consistency in handling of affected rows and result counts across services.
- Modified aggregate functions in SQL queries to use PostgreSQL syntax (e.g., string_agg instead of group_concat).
